questions.question: Verify 1936 versus 1937 for the technical candidate degree and professorial title: the Keldysh Institute biography and MSU chronicle give 1936, while the Academy’s presidential biography gives 1937. Sources: https://keldysh.ru/memory/keldysh/bio.htm ; https://www.letopis.msu.ru/peoples/8641 ; https://www.ras.ru/presidents/5ecea152-dae8-4146-b569-80499038fc40.aspx . The source’s 1937 remains pending a decision.

questions.question: Clarify director of the Institute of Applied Mathematics from 1953: the Applied Mathematics Division was established in 1953 and became an independent institute in 1966. Steklov’s record distinguishes these posts, https://mi.ras.ru/index.php?c=inmemoriapage&id=24591&l=1 . Approve the wording in both versions.

МИАН подробно различает эти должности: https://mi.ras.ru/index.php?c=inmemoriapage&id=24591&l=1 . Согласовать точную формулировку обеих версий.

questions.resolution: Both editions distinguish the division from the independent institute, following the [Steklov Institute’s biography](https://mi.ras.ru/index.php?c=inmemoriapage&id=24591&l=1).
